reason: I'd try the free plan to see if it moves sign-ups, but I wouldn't pay in month one. At $17k a year every euro needs proof, and an AI that clicks and fills forms on my site could embarrass me in front of the few customers I have.
objection: An AI acting on my site could do something wrong in front of my customers, and with my traffic 100 free conversations may be too few to show a real lift in an A/B test.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a measured lift on the free plan with my own traffic, plus a case study from a site my size showing no wrong actions. Then I'd pay for Starter.
